QuestInfo.name: Chaos, Destruction, and the Black Mage
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Lucas, the chief of Amherst, to find out the whole story.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage attacked without warning, and a girl fled up toward the Maple Tree. \r\nGet to that tree!
QuestInfo.2: The Black Mage attacked without warning, and a girl fled up toward the Maple Tree. \r\nYou meet Sugar at the now burning Maple Tree Hill
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 150,000
Can proceed to The Girl and the Maple Tree

0.0: The sky went dark as a shadow fell upon the island. A red eye bored down upon us, and the next thing I knew, Maple Island was in ruins. \r\n#L0##bThat's awful! Why would the Black Mage attack here, of all places?#l\n#k
0.1: I don't know, but I do know this: If he had wanted to, the Black Mage could've utterly destroyed Maple Island. The fact that he didn't makes me suspect has he an ulterior agenda... \r\n#L0##bYou're probably right. Hey, I just noticed... Sugar's not here!#l\n#k
0.2: Who's Sugar? Do you mean that girl who fled toward #bMaple Tree Hill#k while the rest of the town was busy putting out fires? I suppose someone ought to go check on her...

yes.0: I would hate for the girl to suffer if the fire that she didn't help put out spread to the forest...

no.0: We've got the fires under control. Someone should check on that girl.

npc.0: Some girl fled toward #bMaple Tree Hill#k while the rest of the town was busy putting out fires. I suppose someone ought to go check on her...
